Record Class RenderOffsets

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.geysermc.paletter.item.component.RenderOffsets
Record Components:
mainHand - the main hand, or null to leave it out
offHand - the off hand, or null to leave it out
preset - the built-in offsets of an armor piece, or null
All Implemented Interfaces:
ItemComponent, WireOnlyItemComponent
@Deprecated public record RenderOffsets(@Nullable RenderOffsets.Hand mainHand, @Nullable RenderOffsets.Hand offHand, @Nullable RenderOffsets.Preset preset) extends Record implements WireOnlyItemComponent
Deprecated.
retired from the add-on format, still sent for legacy content; will be removed if clients stop honouring it
minecraft:render_offsets: where the item is drawn in each hand, per view.

Retired from the add-on format (Bedrock Dedicated Server 1.26.63.1 rejects it at every format_version). Paletter assumes current clients still honour it on the wire and keeps sending it for legacy content; it will be removed if clients stop honouring it. A RenderOffsets.Preset is the legacy form Geyser sends for armor converted from v1 custom mappings: a bare string render_offsets (no minecraft: prefix, not a component) that names the client's built-in offsets of an armor piece. It is written next to the hands (if any); with only a preset, minecraft:render_offsets is not sent.

Since:
1.0.0
